scope: Focused all-eight-book companion skills and equipment re-audit. Records are observations at their reveal anchors, not a claim of complete possessions or first acquisition. Descriptive labels ending in unnamed distinguish abilities whose canonical names are not supplied.
coverageNotes: Existing Mongo kukri claw caps, Samantha Gurkha hat, Juice Box shapeshifting/possession, and Osvaldo movement skills are not duplicated.
No numerical skill levels were invented from outcomes, narrative adjectives, estimates, or another character's skill.
Mordecai's old-crawl skills in the Book 6 epilogue require supplemental reveal mapping and historical scope; they are deliberately excluded from active current skills.
Sexy Scolopendra has no newly verified possessed equipment or learned skills after her Book 8 pet transformation in this pass. Her former boss attacks are not inherited as pet skills.
Shapeshifted clothing and body parts are not recorded as Juice Box inventory.
All quantity omissions mean unknown quantities. No inventory ownership is inferred from a proposed gift or planned equipment change.
